criteria_results.text: An exact-owner projectless desktop human chat discovered in mobile Chats can be opened and its transcript can be read without treating it as missing from the selected project.
criteria_results.notes: The physical iPhone briefly rendered the desktop transcript but continually flashed back to Opening chat, so it was not stably readable.

criteria_results.text: Opening a chat becomes ready after its bounded message page loads; diff, todos, permissions, and questions refresh afterward and cannot hold the opening screen hostage.
criteria_results.notes: The bounded transcript completed, but the route effect cancelled the ready opener during the transient React commit frame and restarted it.

criteria_results.text: Once the opener reaches ready for the requested chat, a transient render before provider selection state commits must not cancel or reopen it; the transcript remains stable without flashing back to Opening chat.
criteria_results.notes: User report: desktop chat shows the transcript but goes back and forth between Opening chat and showing chat, constantly flashing between. Live desktop logs simultaneously showed repeated aborted upstream fetches.

failure_output: desktop chat shows the transcript but goes back and forth between Opening chat and showing chat. constantly flashing between. Desktop runtime: repeated [MobileOpenCodeProxy] upstream fetch failed (AbortError/UNKNOWN).
suggested_follow_up: Exercise the route against the controller-ready/provider-commit interleaving and prohibit cancellation or reopen when the ready state already matches the requested chat.
